summary: Lightspeed Commerce Inc. filed a Form 6-K with interim financial statements and MD&A for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, along with CEO/CFO certifications. The filing is a routine quarterly report by a foreign private issuer, containing no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital return. Financial results show a net loss of $2.4 million, down from a $49.6 million loss, with a gain on sale of business noted but not detailed. No deal terms, board actions, or advisors are mentioned.
